title: Earnings Debit Set-Off on Re-Sent Payouts (Cartwise Shopper Payouts)
content:
Treasury set-off rules — Cartwise Shopper Payouts, re-sent payouts.

**Rule 1 (set-off).** From the amount drawn for a re-send of a returned payout, one earnings debit booked on the account is set off, and which debit is chosen depends on the return history:

- (a) an account with two or more returned-transfer entries in the last 12 months sets off the largest earnings debit ever booked on the account;
- (b) an account with exactly one returned-transfer entry in the last 12 months whose shopper is below Full-Service Shopper Diamond level sets off the most recently booked earnings debit;
- (c) any other account sets off nothing.

The amount set off is taken off the amount drawn; the re-send never falls below zero, and whatever is not re-sent stays on the balance.

**Rule 2 (terms used).**

- An *earnings debit* is an entry on the payout account taking a batch tip reduction or a batch pay reversal from the unpaid earnings balance.
- A *returned-transfer entry* is the entry booked when a deposit or cashout came back from the receiving bank or card.
- "The last 12 months" counts the entries booked fewer than 12 whole months before the day of the re-send. Rule 1(a) looks at every earnings debit ever booked, not only those in the last 12 months.
- Shopper levels rank upward in the order Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum and Full-Service Shopper Diamond; "below Full-Service Shopper Diamond" means any level up to and including Full-Service Shopper Platinum.

**Rule 3 (combinations).**

| Returned-transfer entries in the last 12 months | Shopper level | Set-off |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more | Any | The largest earnings debit ever booked |
| Exactly one | Full-Service Shopper Platinum or below | The most recently booked earnings debit |
| Exactly one | Full-Service Shopper Diamond | Nothing |
| None | Any | Nothing |

**Hypothetical cases.** An account has earnings debits of 12.00 (booked two years ago), 4.50 and 7.25 (the most recent).
- With three returned-transfer entries in the last 12 months, 12.00 is set off.
- With one returned-transfer entry in the last 12 months and a Full-Service Shopper Gold shopper, 7.25 is set off.
- With one returned-transfer entry in the last 12 months and a Full-Service Shopper Diamond shopper, nothing is set off.
